description: Trust in virtual teams This cluster talks about virtual teams, compares trust in computermediated versus face-face teams, discusses communication and trust in global virtual teams, and describes the dynamic nature of trust in virtual teams.

Importance of empowerment, trust, cultural diversity, task interdependence and knowledge sharing This cluster explores the role of team empowerment in virtual teams, the role of cultural diversity in teams, the role of trust in virtual teams, and the challenges of virtual teams for leadership and the typology of virtual teams, and discusses trust, task interdependence, and virtualness in knowledgesharing in teams.

Conflicts in virtual teams This cluster discusses different dimensions and degrees of team dispersion in virtual teams; conflicts in distributed teams; and the meaning of shared identity, shared context, and spontaneous communication in geographically distributed teams.

Challenges in virtual teams This cluster explores challenges (trust, process gains, isolation, balancing technical and interpersonal skills, and assessment and recognition of performance) of virtual teams; discusses the role of behavior control on trust decline in virtual teams; and explores the impact of trust and communication on the effectiveness of open source software teams.
Knowledge sharing in dispersed teams This cluster discusses knowledge coordination and virtual team performance, the mutual knowledge problem, and situated knowledge and learning in dispersed teams.

Effectiveness of virtual teams This cluster explores virtual team dynamics and effectiveness; differences between global, virtual, and co-located new product development; and technology adaptation in virtual teams.
